01

The commerce context

Osher Market brings buyers, sellers, and business operations together in a commerce platform. Behind the storefront, the product depends on application services that keep those workflows connected.

02

My contribution

My contribution is backend development. I work on the services and application logic that support the marketplace experience.

03

The backend approach

That work calls for clear boundaries between requests, business rules, and data. I focus on making the system understandable as a whole, rather than treating each endpoint as an isolated task.

Osher represents the operational side of my engineering work: building the foundations that allow a product interface to do something useful.
